data.title: Zelle Recipient Enumeration via Multiple Failed Lookups
data.description: Detects multiple failed Zelle recipient lookups from a single account or session, which may indicate enumeration activity. Attackers probe email addresses and phone numbers to identify which are registered with Zelle before launching targeted social engineering or authorized push payment attacks against confirmed users.
